fields.statement: At 34815079 (attempt 2, fix for model finding f1): read the fix diff; it only amends the to-be statements of run-resume, manual-resume-refuses-unaccepted and Decision manual-resume-refuses to name the exception (a plan-workflow run whose change set has landed is resumed), keeping the original wording otherwise; rhiza show --change confirms all three now read that way, so the to-be model no longer states two contradictory rules. Code is unchanged since 92222406 (internal/api/run.go exempts only landed and only for workflow plan). go test ./cmd/rhiza -count=1 -run 'TestScripts/(run-resume-landed-plan|run-resume-unaccepted|run-resume)$' passes: the plan run resumes past its wait after its record landed and succeeds; the landed ship-change run and the withdrawn plan run each exit non-zero naming the state and 'next: rhiza run abandon <id>', journals cmp-identical. fmt-check, go vet and make self-check pass. Full go test ./... failed only on TestReadBudget, TestBudget (timing) and arbiter-agent-tabs under load average ~13; arbiter-agent-tabs passes rerun alone, and this commit touches only .rhiza/ files.
